card.name: Drug-class lists in interaction sections
card.fires_on: Words inside or right after a drug-class name in interaction text, where a further class or drug name is about to follow. Examples are 'or' in 'Macrolide or ketolide', 'Muscle' before 'relaxants', and the end of 'MAOIs' or 'respiratory'.

modes.label: Class name joined by or
modes.description: The word 'or' linking two drug classes at the start of an interaction entry.

modes.label: Partway through a class name
modes.description: The ending of a class name such as respiratory depressants or MAOIs, just before the next term.
modes.example: CONCOMITANT ADMINISTRATION OF PROMETHAZINE PRODUCTS WITH OTHER RESPIR<<ATORY>> DEPRESSANTS HAS AN ASSOCIATION

modes.label: Muscle before relaxants
modes.description: The word 'Muscle' as the start of the heading 'Muscle relaxants' in interaction lists.
modes.example: 7.7<< Muscle>> Relaxants Codeine may enhance the neu
